architecture.normalization: Public fixed numerical anchors; accurate baseline measurements validate the environment and do not alter score scales
architecture.throughput: STA-certified frequency / minimum verified frame II; FFTs/s
architecture.latency: worst first-input to first-output cycles multiplied by common target period 10ns; no additional frequency reward

fmax_scan.method: clock reconstraint and full STA update on the fixed mapped netlist; score uses passing endpoint
fmax_scan.hold: report min-path slack; certification requires no observed negative hold slack

normalized_terms.latency: clip((L_max-L)/(L_max-L_ideal),0,1); L measured in cycles at the common clock

feasibility: mandatory numerical, continuous 384-cycle service, reset, latency, setup/hold and representative RTL/mapped consistency; optional shorter-II failures recorded separately
score: feasible * weighted sum of normalized terms; feasible is independent of score
freeze_policy: Public weights, functions and numeric anchors are fixed before an evaluated run; candidate results never change them during that run

evaluation.ii_search: all integers 64..384; optional shorter failures do not invalidate mandatory service

feedback: Complete public evaluation returns measured components and combined preview score without private calibration. Hidden grading additionally requires matching private validation calibration.
